interest: Offers unique primary documentation on founding the National Diet Library and early postwar Japanese parliamentary operations.
keywords: United States Library Mission to Japan
overview: This file documents the development, administration, and early operations of Japan's National Diet under Allied occupation between 1947 and 1949. It is largely centered on the establishment of the National Diet Library, featuring the comprehensive 1948 United States Library Mission report by Verner W. Clapp alongside related enabling legislation. Additionally, the collection contains SCAP Government Section procedural regulations for Diet committees, a detailed legislative summary of bills and budgets from the First National Diet, intelligence airgrams regarding Japan Communist Party discipline and political candidacy, and official correspondence approving a 1950 U.S. study tour for Japanese parliamentarians.
